verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents experimentation and a 'Choosing a metric type' page, which suggests user-defined metrics, likely built from tracked events. The pack has only titles, though, so it is unclear how those metrics are built or whether they come from the user's own event data. Missing for 10: any evidence of warehouse-native metrics defined from warehouse tables, detail on building metrics from ingested custom events, transparency into metric computation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
